data.title: Desktop: Tauri wrap + Actions release pipeline + download links

data.body: Implemented: (1) src-tauri/ tauri v2 scaffold — minimal (no plugins, core:default capability only), productName pattern-maker, window title 'pattern maker PM–1' 1440x900 min 900x640, version 0.1.0 aligned with package.json; (2) icon set from a 1024px PM-1 mark (16px favicon geometry x64, transparent AA rounded corners r=224) rendered by a zero-dep scratchpad PNG encoder, emitted via npx tauri icon; (3) .github/workflows/release.yml — tauri-action@v0, tag v*, mac aarch64+x86_64 / ubuntu-22.04 / windows matrix, contents:write, rust-cache; (4) masthead 'desktop ↓' link to releases/latest, label-gray mono, hover ink, hidden via __TAURI_INTERNALS__ guard; (5) gitignore src-tauri/target + gen. Verified: cargo check green (38s), npx tsc --noEmit + npm run build green, actionlint + ruby YAML parse clean on release.yml, npx tauri info parses config, 1024px and 32px icons visually confirmed (badge/grid/orange LED read). Deviations: deleted CLI-emitted android/ + ios/ icon dirs (desktop-only app); kept the Windows Square*Logo pngs the CLI emits. Committed Cargo.lock (application convention). Not done here per orchestrator: no push, no v0.1.0 tag. Commits 409e8f1, 7635b4d, 78fe67a.

REVIEW (fresh context, vs plan task_01KZSF0CD18RCTGV1M0B1R3XAQ, commits 409e8f1/7635b4d/78fe67a): PASS. Scaffold: Cargo.toml minimal (tauri v2 features=[], no plugins), release profile lto/strip; tauri.conf.json — identifier com.forrestalmasi.pattern-maker, version 0.1.0 == package.json, productName 'pattern-maker' (artifact-safe) with window title 'pattern maker PM-1' split per plan, frontendDist ../dist, beforeBuildCommand npm run build, window 1440x900 min 900x640, bundle targets dmg/msi/nsis/appimage/deb + standard icon list; capabilities/default.json = core:default only on ['main'] (matches implicit main label); main.rs sane. cargo check passes (1.1s, cached). npx tauri info parses config with no complaints (Xcode-missing is local env only). Icons: full set committed (icns/ico/pngs incl. Square*); viewed 32px + 128px — badge, 3x3 grid, orange center read correctly. release.yml: actionlint clean; matrix = macos aarch64 + x86_64 (--target args, both targets installed via dtolnay/rust-toolchain), ubuntu-22.04 (webkit2gtk-4.1-dev + appindicator + rsvg + patchelf), windows-latest; contents:write; swatinem/rust-cache workspaces=src-tauri keyed per matrix.args; tauri-action@v0 with GITHUB_TOKEN, tagName v__VERSION__, releaseName 'pattern maker __VERSION__', draft/prerelease false — sound for first tag push. Masthead link: 'desktop ↓' anchor guarded by '__TAURI_INTERNALS__' in window, href github.com/malls/pattern-maker/releases/latest, target=_blank rel=noopener (safe; fine for an external escape hatch), styled with existing tokens only (--label/--ink/--orange, mono 10px matching .tagline; baseline flex alignment preserved; focus-visible outline present, so keyboard flow ok). Hygiene: git ls-files shows no target/ or gen/ committed (only Cargo.lock 107KB + icons, both intentional); .gitignore covers src-tauri/target/ and src-tauri/gen/; @tauri-apps/cli in devDependencies only, zero runtime deps; npx tsc --noEmit + npm run build clean. Expected post-tag caveats (not defects): /releases/latest 404s until v0.1.0 is tagged; 4 matrix jobs share one release via tauri-action's normal create-or-reuse behavior. No defects found. -> done.
